metadata.title: Lexon AI | Private Contract Intelligence Platform
metadata.description: Private contract intelligence platform for NDA review, contract analysis, vendor agreement review, policy validation, redline recommendations, and procurement risk intelligence. Deploy fully offline on your infrastructure with no external API dependency.

openGraph.description: Private contract intelligence for NDA review, vendor agreement review, policy validation, and enterprise compliance.

structuredData.name: Lexon AI | Private Contract Intelligence Platform
structuredData.description: Private contract intelligence platform for NDA review, vendor agreement review, policy compliance, redline recommendations, and vendor risk analysis.

hero.headline: Private Contract Intelligence
hero.subhead: Built for organizations that want every contract reviewed against their own policies, playbooks, and legal knowledge.

problems.title: Sensitive contracts cannot leave your infrastructure
problems.description: NDAs, procurement agreements, and legal strategy documents require strict internal handling.

problems.title: Cloud-based AI introduces security and compliance concerns
problems.description: Uploading contracts to third-party APIs reduces visibility and control over sensitive information.

problems.title: Legal workflows are fragmented across disconnected tools
problems.description: Teams lack a unified private system for legal review, policy enforcement, and contract intelligence.

knowledge_layer.headline: Your Legal Knowledge Powers Every Review
knowledge_layer.subhead: Build your legal knowledge base once. Every future contract is reviewed against it. The more you use it, the smarter it gets.

items.title: Policies & Playbooks
items.description: Upload your company policies, approved standards, and legal playbooks. Every contract is validated against them.

items.title: Reference Contracts
items.description: Your best negotiations become the reference library. New contracts are compared against your approved standards.

items.title: Type-Specific Rules
items.description: NDA, DPA, MSA, Vendor — each document type has tailored analysis, risk detection, and rewrite templates.

roadmap.title: NDA Review Engine
roadmap.description: Analyze clauses, obligations, restrictions, and legal risks in NDAs within seconds.

roadmap.title: Risk Detection Engine
roadmap.description: Identify problematic clauses, negotiation risks, and policy violations with high accuracy.

roadmap.title: Decision Intelligence
roadmap.description: Provides policy-aware recommendations to support consistent review decisions.

roadmap.title: Contract Playbook Engine
roadmap.description: Validate agreements against approved legal playbooks, fallback clauses, and company standards.

roadmap.title: Redline Recommendation System
roadmap.description: Suggest safer clause replacements and negotiation-ready fallback language.

roadmap.title: Approval Workflow Intelligence
roadmap.description: Automatically route agreements to legal, finance, procurement, or compliance reviewers.

roadmap.title: Policy-to-Contract Validation
roadmap.description: Detect conflicts between contracts, procurement rules, privacy requirements, and internal policies.

roadmap.title: Multi-Document Reasoning
roadmap.description: Compare NDAs, vendor agreements, DPAs, MSAs, and related contracts simultaneously.

roadmap.title: Obligation Extraction & Tracking
roadmap.description: Extract deadlines, renewals, deliverables, payment terms, and compliance obligations automatically.

roadmap.title: Vendor Risk Intelligence
roadmap.description: Analyze liability exposure, procurement risks, jurisdiction conflicts, indemnity terms, and data obligations.

roadmap.title: Legal Knowledge Graph
roadmap.description: Connect vendors, clauses, obligations, departments, and risks into searchable legal intelligence.

roadmap.title: Integration Platform
roadmap.description: Process and review contracts within daily communication tools — messaging platforms, email workflows, and procurement systems.

foundation.title: Air-Gapped Enterprise Deployment
foundation.description: Fully isolated deployment for banking, healthcare, government, and defense environments.

foundation.title: Audit Trails & Decision History
foundation.description: Track AI reasoning, reviewer approvals, policy violations, and contract decision history.

foundation.title: Role-Based Legal Access
foundation.description: Department-specific access controls for legal, procurement, finance, compliance, and executive teams.

foundation.title: Private AI Assistant
foundation.description: Document-grounded Q&A for contract follow-up questions, policy interpretation, and clause reasoning.

principles.title: Privacy is architecture
principles.description: Offline and self-hosted deployment keeps legal data within your infrastructure.

principles.title: Security by default
principles.description: No external API dependency and no customer data used for AI model training.

principles.title: AI augments legal teams
principles.description: Automate repetitive review while lawyers focus on negotiation and strategy.

trust_statement.title: Built for Sensitive Contract Operations
trust_statement.description: Privacy-preserving infrastructure designed for organizations handling confidential contracts and regulated data.

controls.title: Role-based access control
controls.description: Granular permissions for administrators, reviewers, and stakeholders

controls.title: Audit logging
controls.description: Traceable review history with tamper-evident logs
